2. Dashboard Usage Guide
2.2 Components by Page > MONITORING RESULTS > Spec Monitoring
Dashboard Screen Feature Guide
Compare product specifications collected from LG.com with the reference
specifications and check the differences by page.
1 Business Unit and Country
Select a business unit and country to filter the results. Select All to view all available
results.
2 Issue Filter
Check the flagged page count and differences by issue type. Select an issue card to filter
the list. Click “Clear filter” to reset it.
3 Page Details
Find the page or model in the list and click Detail to compare the reference specification
values with those collected from LG.com.

2. Dashboard Usage Guide
2.2 Components by Page > REFERENCE > Monitoring Item > Total Score
Dashboard Screen Feature Guide
Check the monitoring items and points for CAT/PLP, PDP, and Shared in this
page.
1 Page Type
Find the column for the page type you want to check, such as CAT/PLP, PDP, or a shared
area.
2 Only Monitoring
Check this section for items that the dashboard tracks without adding them to the total
score.
3 Total Score
Each page type has a maximum score of 100 points. Only the scored items contribute to
3 this total.
